bar.volPassthrough: Volume on your TV or receiver: this sound goes to it as it is.

playback.title: Playback
playback.exoHint: Plays every screen: Live TV, Plex, VOD, Multi-Screen, Backups.
playback.mpvHint: Live TV channels and the Live/Guide preview boxes only.
playback.mpvGainNote: On MPV, volume past 100% is plain gain — no boost limiter (that's an ExoPlayer-only feature for now).
playback.footnote: Built from up to the last 30 Live TV watches per engine on this box — one reading 60 s in and one when it stops.
playback.matchFrameRateDesc: Films and episodes switch the TV to their own frame rate (24p films at 24 Hz) for smooth motion. The screen goes black for a moment when a film starts. Live TV is never changed.
playback.decodeAudioDesc: For a TV or receiver that shows the film but plays no sound: Dolby and DTS are then decoded here instead of being passed through. Leave off for the best sound.

multi.needsAppTitle: Multi-Screen needs the Fire TV / Android app
multi.needsAppBody: Multi-Screen runs four native video players at once, which the web preview can't do. Open the installed app on your Fire TV or Android device.
